================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO OO LOOGU TALAGALAY AFTER EFFECTS - WAXA CUSUB
Nooca 9.2.8  -  Oktoobar 2026
================================================================================

Guddigu hadda wuxuu ku hadlaa 132 AF, waxaa jira MUUQAALLO cusub oo DEMON SLAYER ah oo leh
seef gooya badhamada aad riixdo, iyo dhowr hagaajin oo qaabka iyo Windows ah.

INTA AAN LA BILAABIN
- Ku rakib nooca hadda jira adigoo isticmaalaya rakibaha ZXP ee caadiga ah, ka dibna hal mar dib u bilow
  After Effects.
- Dejintaada, muuqaalkaaga, presets-kaaga iyo expressions-ka aad kaydisay waa la hayaa.

CUSUB: GUDDIGA OO 132 AF AH
- Flex Dejinta > AFKA hadda wuxuu muujiyaa 132 af, oo leh sanduuq raadin. Dooro
  mid, guddiga oo dhanna wuu is beddelayaa: tabyada, badhamada, tilmaamaha, fariimaha.
- Af kasta waxaa tarjumay AI iyadoo laga soo bilaabay guddiga Ingiriisiga ah, ma aha
  eray-eray. Magacyada aad ku aragto mashruucaaga (magacyada lakabyada, magacyada saamaynta) waxay ku sii jiraan
  Ingiriisi si ay weli ula mid noqdaan After Effects.
- Daaqadda soo baxda ee “Waxa cusub” sidoo kale waa la tarjumay, laga bilaabo sii deyntan.

CUSUB: MUUQAALLADA DEMON SLAYER
- Flex Dejinta > DOORASHADA MUUQAALKA waxay leedahay koox cusub oo DEMON SLAYER ah oo 11 muuqaal ah:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen iyo Kokushibo.
- Mouse-ka dhaqaaji guddiga dushiisa, curiyaha muuqaalkuna wuu raacayaa: biyo,
  olol, hillaac, balanbaalis, caleemaha ubaxa, ceeryaamo iyo wax kale. Marka mouse-ku
  istaago, wuu baaba'aa.
- Riix badhan, seefta jilaagaasna way gooyaysaa. Hayso badhanka bidix
  adigoo riixaya, way sii gooyaysaa; haddii aad hayso ilaa 2.5 ilbiriqsi, wuuna qarxaa.
- Waxaa loo sameeyay inay fudud ahaadaan: saamayntu waxay shaqaysaa kaliya markaad dhaqaajiso ama riixdo, waxayna
  is-fududaysaa kombiyuutarrada gaabiska ah. Dami SAAMAYNTA DEEGAANKA
  ee Doorashada Muuqaalka si aad u hayso midabada oo keliya.

LA BEDDELAY: BADHAMO SIMAN MUUQAAL KASTA
- Badhamada firfircoon iyo kuwa ugu muhiimsan ee muuqaallada midabka leh mar dambe ma isticmaalaan
  gradient hadh leh oo kor ilaa hoos ah. Waa hal midab siman oo leh dhalaal jilicsan, sidaa darteed
  way nadiif u muuqdaan oo si fiican ayaa loo akhriyaa.

LAGA HAGAAJIYAY
- Kaarka shatiga iyo daaqadda soo baxda ee “Waxa cusub” way isku furmi karayeen mid kale dushiisa.
  Hadda weligood isma dabooli, calaamadda CUSBOONAYSIINTA-na mar dambe ma daboosho
  badhamada dusha sare ee guddiga.
- Marka CABBIRKA UI uu yahay 125% iyo 150%, daaqado qaar (sida Flex Dejinta) way ka dheeraan karayeen
  guddiga, sidaa darteed badhanka xidhitaanku wuu ka baxayay muuqaalka. Daaqad kasta
  hadda way ku habboon tahay cabbir kasta.
- Windows: AutoCaptions wuxuu odhan karay “DRAYBARKA NVIDIA WAA AAD U DUUG CAPTIONS-KA GPU-GA”
  kaararka iyo draybarrada cusub (taxanaha RTX 40 iyo 50) markii la isticmaalo. Hadda si sax ah ayuu u akhriyaa
  taageerada CUDA ee draybarka, wuxuuna isticmaalaa GPU-gaaga.

LAMA BEDDELIN
- Shatiyeynta, hawlgelinta iyo isku-xirka kasta waxay u shaqeeyaan sidii hore oo kale.
- Tab kasta oo kale iyo qalab kasta waxay u shaqeeyaan sida saxda ah ee 9.2.7.
================================================================================

FLEX ULTIMATE OO LOOGU TALAGALAY PREMIERE PRO - WAXA CUSUB
Nooca 2.2.8  -  Oktoobar 2026

Captions-ka CAPTION STACK hadda waa qaabab Motion Graphics oo LA TIFTIIRI KARO oo leh
tifaftire dhab ah, waxaa jira AUDIO STUDIO cusub iyo MARK AUDIO BEATS, guddigu wuxuu ku hadlaa 132
AF, CABBIRKA UI wuxuu yimid ULTIMATE, waxaana jira MUUQAALLO cusub oo DEMON SLAYER ah.

INTA AAN LA BILAABIN
- Ku rakib nooca hadda jira adigoo isticmaalaya rakibaha ZXP ee caadiga ah, ka dibna hal mar dib u bilow
  Premiere Pro.
- Dejintaada, muuqaalkaaga iyo presets-kaaga waa la hayaa.

CUSUB: CAPTION STACK - CAPTIONS LA TIFTIIRI KARO (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Captions-ka hadda waxaa loo dhigaa qaabab Motion Graphics oo la tifaftiri karo (Soo-saar >
  MOGRT LA TIFTIIRI KARO, kan cusub ee caadiga ah ee Premiere Pro 2026). Marka la dhigo kadib,
  beddel eray kasta, farta, midabka, cabbirka, booska, dhalaalka, khadka dhinaca, sanduuqa,
  animation-ka ama wakhtiga gudaha guddiga Essential Graphics ee Premiere.
- Soo-saar > SAWIRRO weli wuxuu dhigaa eray kasta sida sawir leh muuqaal sax ah,
  haddii aad taas doorbidayso.
- Qaababka waxay la yimaadaan guddiga. Wax la soo dejiyo ma jiro.

CUSUB: TIFTIIRAHA CAPTION STACK
- Horu-eegiska hadda wuxuu muujiyaa firaamka dhabta ah ee fiidiyahaaga hoostiisa caption kasta.
- Jiid caption si aad u dhaqaajiso, isticmaal geeska si aad u beddesho cabbirka iyo dhibicda sare si aad
  u wareejiso, laba jeer ku dhufo eray si aad u tifaftirto. CAPTION-KA OO DHAN wuxuu wada dhaqaajiyaa
  erayada oo dhan, HAL ERAY wuxuu dhaqaajiyaa hal eray oo keliya.
- Dooro in isbeddelku quseeyo caption kasta mise caption-kan oo keliya, kuna
  kaydi habaynnadaada si aad mar kale u isticmaasho.
- 10 muuqaal oo GLOW ah oo cusub: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow iyo Superb.

CUSUB: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Dooro clip cod ah, dooro saamayn oo riix SHAQEYSI. Wax walba waxay ka shaqeeyaan
  kombiyuutarkaaga.
- 30 hordejin oo hal gujin ah: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse iyo kuwo kale. Isku-dar
  saamayn intaad rabto, dib u habee ama mid damiso.
- Reverb wuxuu hayaa dabadiisa: codku wuu sii dhawaaqayaa dhammaadka clip-ka ka dib, waxaana la dhigaa si
  aan wax ka mid ah timeline-kaaga loo bedelin.
- Qalab: Ka-saarista Buuqa, Hagaajinta Codka, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Ka-saarista Hum, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Xawaaraha
  iyo Pitch, Noise Gate, Soo-saarista Codka.
- STEMS MAKER wuxuu heesta u kala qaybiyaa cod (vocals) iyo muusig (ama 4 stems). Wuxuu soo dejiyaa
  model-kiisa markii ugu horreysa, wuxuuna ku weydiiyaa marka hore.
- HORU-EEGIS wuxuu kuu ogolaanayaa inaad dhegaysato ilaa 8 ilbiriqsi adigoo isticmaalaya furaha Original / Processed.
  Natiijada waxaa lagu dhigaa track cod ah oo bannaan, clip-kaaga asalka ahna waa la aamusiiyaa,
  weligiis lama tirtiro.

CUSUB: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Dooro clip muusig ah timeline-ka oo riix MARK BEATS: Flex wuxuu helaa
  beats-ka wuxuuna ku daraa calaamado sequence-ka, si goynahaagu si sax ah
  ugu dhegaan muusigga.
- Dooro DHAMMAAN dhibcaha, KICKS ama SNARES, deji dareenka (sensitivity), oo calaamadi beat kasta ama
  beat kasta oo labaad ama afraad.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS wuxuu tirtiraa oo keliya calaamadaha uu Flex ku daray. Wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa
  kombiyuutarkaaga.
